entries.explanation: Private reference insert is called only inside the authenticated Canvas transaction, after owned live thread, current-person/scope, admission (when a run is used), provenance and CAS checks. Same-design snapshot FK enforces identity; no narrow-role access is added.

Private reference lookup is an internal Canvas metadata helper. Its caller loads the owned live canvas/thread and rechecks current-person/area access in the authenticated Canvas transaction before returning metadata; this helper is not a public action.

Private snapshot read requires canvas owner_user_id to equal the current person, then asserts active owner/staff Projects plus scoped Leads and refuses templates, checks current design/canvas scope. Caller separately enforces live owned thread and canvas required areas. Successful reads share the full-designer edit gate and return canEdit=true; no denied target returns preview data.

Owner-DB web deletion preflight now runs after lockPlanDesign and assertFloorAccess with explicit full-designer template policy, in the same transaction as DELETE. Links/titles are returned only when every reference is owned/live/unheld with owned live thread and current required area/scope access; foreign, retained, held or revoked references use the fixed generic refusal and no links. No narrow SELECT privilege is added.
